blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected all five regenerated product views and all six regenerated poses. The jacket remains nearly featureless white: no readable broad fencing plastron or rear waist adjustment is visible; elbow diamonds and diagonal marking read only as faint contour lines.
Direct inspection of neutral, arms-up, arm-cross and prone renders shows dense irregular faceting and wrinkles across the sleeves and underarms. Sleeve surface quality remains visibly rough.

Direct inspection of the current views and poses shows an uncontrolled skirt that separates into flaps in crouch and lifts in sitting, exposing large gaps around blunt cylindrical shorts. Same-pose projection records posterior-pelvis shorts coverage of 14.5% neutral, 17.7% crouch and 19.0% sit; overskirt coverage is 65.8%, 59.0% and 60.7%, with crouch/sit p95 gaps of 80.6/115.5 mm. The raised inner-crotch point did not materially resolve coverage. These geometric measurements are diagnostics only and do not establish fit acceptance.
The collar remains a narrow upright open tube. The diagonal piping does not form a visible plastron or secure-looking closure, and neck clearance remains unestablished.

These are Blender prototype renders and pose-matched geometry diagnostics only. Shape Key fit, continuous penetration, accepted deformation weights, Unity prefab integration, VRChat Build & Test and SDK upload remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
